name: Deloitte Strategy (Monitor Deloitte / Deloitte Consulting Strategy)
one_liner: Strategy arm of Deloitte, the largest Big 4 network, combining Monitor Group's strategy heritage with Deloitte's implementation and technology scale.
at_a_glance: Monitor Deloitte formed when Deloitte acquired Monitor Group (2013).
US MBA Strategy summer associates are hired into Deloitte Consulting LLP across roughly 18 US cities.
Part of Deloitte's global Big 4 network of several hundred thousand people.
Focus areas include corporate and growth strategy, M&A, customer strategy, and technology/AI strategy.

rounds: First round: behavioral interview plus 1-2 case interviews (~30-45 min each).
Final round: behavioral interview, a case, and often a group case; some teams use a written or presentation case.
interview_process.case_style: Mostly candidate-led cases; formats can include a data packet with prep time before presenting, or a group case where teamwork is observed.
interview_process.fit_style: Structured behavioral interviews on leadership, teamwork, and handling ambiguity; Deloitte publishes behavioral interview tips for candidates.
interview_process.assessments: None standard for MBA strategy roles as far as public sources show.

what_they_look_for: Big-picture thinking on complex, ambiguous problems
culture: Scale of Deloitte lets strategy teams follow work into implementation.
Collaborative, team-oriented environment; group cases reflect that emphasis.
More defined practice areas than MBB generalist models.
why_us_angles: How does moving from strategy to implementation within one firm fit your product-building background?
Which Deloitte Strategy area (e.g., customer, M&A, supply chain, AI) maps to your experience?
Why does the Monitor strategy heritage plus Deloitte scale appeal to you?
If you've worked at Deloitte (or another Big 4) before, what shapes how you see the firm?
prep_tips: Practice a presentation-style case: read a data packet, build a few pages, present to a senior interviewer.
Prepare for group cases: contribute early, build on others, and help drive to an answer.
Use Deloitte's five-step case approach: understand, assumptions, key findings, recommendation, next steps.
If you've worked in audit or at a Big 4 firm, be ready to explain why strategy now.
